name: smwpatches-preserve-direct-page-and-scratch-ram-on-interrupts
title: Preserve Direct Page and Scratch RAM on Interrupts
description:
This patch preserves the direct page register while the game is running in NMI or in an IRQ, which allows you to tweak it for your own needs in custom code.

Additionally, it allows you to preserve up to 16 bytes of scratch RAM in the $00-$0F range, during NMI only as to not waste IRQ time. By default it saves 5 bytes, RAM addresses $00-$04.

Doesn't work with SA-1, as that patch already enables this functionality.
